Static renderer called from CustomUnit draw passes with (drawOverBody, drawUnderAllUnits) booleans; it filters LegOrArmTemplate.drawOverBody/drawUnderAllUnits, applies hidden/alpha checks, draws shadows, feet/end images, middle/leg images, and optional link lines.

The method iterates CustomUnit.attachedUnits, checks each AttachmentSlot.showAllActionsFrom LogicBoolean, wraps child actions in UnitSpecificActionProxy, and appends them to the UI action list. It does not detach or clean a list.

CustomUnit.dB iterates legRuntimeStates, sets fallingReset and needsPositionReset on each LegRuntimeState, then refreshes leg placement. The old markAttachmentsFalling name was inaccurate; this method only touches leg runtime states.

CustomUnit.du creates/resizes dT to match metadata.legOrArmTemplates, initializes LegRuntimeState.index and alpha from each template, snapshots unit position/height/dir, then refreshes leg runtime states.
CustomUnit.dv directly invokes LegAnimationBehavior.instance.onLateUpdate(this, 0) to recompute leg runtime placement immediately after allocation or falling reset.

CustomUnit.e(boolean) clears attachedUnitActionBuffer, calls AttachmentBehavior.collectAttachedUnitActions when attachment slots exist, and returns the buffer only if exposed attached-unit actions were added.
